name: API2UI
author: Wongani Kaluwa

sections.description:
API2UI allows you to connect external APIs to your WordPress website and display their responses on the frontend using configurable user interfaces.

Instead of manually writing API integration code for every page, API2UI provides an interface where you can configure API endpoints, request methods, response parameters and frontend layouts.

Key Features:

Connect to external REST APIs.

Supports GET and POST requests.

Configure API response parameters using nested JSON paths.

Create reusable frontend interfaces.

Display API data using customizable HTML layouts.

Use dynamic data placeholders to populate your UI.

Generate shortcodes for easy integration into WordPress pages and posts.

Shortcodes

Use the generated shortcode to display your configured interface.

Example:

[api2ui id=”190″]
sections.installation:
Download API2UI plugin from the wordpress plugin directory

Activate API2UI through the WordPress Plugins menu.

Navigate to the API2UI menu in your WordPress dashboard.

Create a new API2UI configuration.

Configure your API endpoint, request method and response parameters.

Design your frontend layout.

Save your configuration and copy the generated shortcode.

Paste the shortcode into any WordPress page or post.
sections.faq:
What is API2UI?

API2UI is a WordPress plugin that connects external APIs to customizable frontend interfaces.

Does it support POST requests?

Yes. API2UI supports GET and POST requests.

Can I display nested JSON data?

Yes. You can specify a nested response path using slash-separated parameters.

Example: data/content/items

How do I display API data?

Create a configuration, save it and insert its generated shortcode into your WordPress page or post.
